Prompts

```
['run the mingw.py CLI to download a specific MinGW version for a given architecture', 'call root() to download and return the root folder of a specific MinGW variant', 'call repository() to download and parse MinGW-builds repository files into a versions dictionary', 'call unpack() to extract a MinGW-builds archive to a specified location using 7zip', 'call find_in_path() to locate an executable file in the system PATH directories']
```

```
{'run_mingw_cli': 'run the mingw.py CLI to download a specific MinGW version for a given architecture', 'download_mingw_with_root': 'call root() to download and return the root folder of a specific MinGW variant', 'fetch_repository_versions': 'call repository() to download and parse MinGW-builds repository files into a versions dictionary', 'unpack_archive_with_7zip': 'call unpack() to extract a MinGW-builds archive to a specified location using 7zip', 'find_executable_in_path': 'call find_in_path() to locate an executable file in the system PATH directories'}
```
